name: context-window
title: Context window
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Segmented context window for an agent. Sources load into a tick bar, pinned rows stay put, and crossing a threshold asks the host before chat becomes a summary.

meta.descriptionEs: Ventana de contexto del agente. Las fuentes entran en una barra de ticks, lo fijado no se compacta, y al cruzar el umbral el anfitrión decide si la charla pasa a resumen.

examples.title: 80 000 tokens
examples.description: Recorrido de carga y compactación. En Error el primer quitar se deshace.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Cuarenta fuentes, 0 y 2 millones de tokens, nombres largos, todo fijado y eventos desordenados.

meta.usage: <ContextWindow sources={sources} modelLimit={80000} warnAt={{ unit: "percent", value: 75 }} compactAt={{ unit: "percent", value: 90 }} onThreshold={onThreshold} onPinChange={onPinChange} onEvictRequest={onEvictRequest} />

api.name: sources / model
api.description: Rows: kind, tokens, status, cached, cacheTokens, pinned, label, summaryOf. model also carries the last compact.

api.name: modelLimit / resolveLimit
api.description: Window size. resolveLimit is the host bridge for model-router. That branch is not imported. A positive resolver result wins.

api.name: warnAt / compactAt / onThreshold
api.description: Lines in percent or tokens. The callback fires once when usage crosses upward. The host decides whether to compact.

api.name: applyContextEvent
api.description: Pure reducer for load, update, evict, compact, pin, and unpin. Duplicates and wrong order are ignored. Pinned rows are not compacted.

api.name: onPinChange / onEvictRequest
api.description: Controlled actions. The row updates immediately and rolls back if the promise rejects. Pinned rows cannot be removed until they are unpinned.

api.name: pricing / currency
api.description: Stand-in for the cost-waterfall rate table: input, output, cache read, and cache write per 1M. Intl formats the currency.

api.name: labels / locale
api.description: English is the default. contextWindowLabelsEs is es-MX. Pass locale so counts and currency match.

docs: Clean-room del comportamiento público del find Context window de Juliette (@shedsgns) en bencho.dev. Esa página no publica código ni licencia; el MIT de Bencho cubre bloques gratis con panel de código, no finds, y la licencia Pro prohíbe republicar bloques como librería. No se copió código, datos, iconos ni assets. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene, responde no. La pieza no trae tema, cssVars ni colores fijos. model-router y cost-waterfall viven en otras ramas y no se importan: el límite entra por resolveLimit y el costo por PricingLike.
